description: Known circuits: venue aliases, nominal length and (only where the order and positions are verified) the named corners. apex_fraction is the approximate position of the corner apex as a fraction of the lap length, measured from the start/finish line of the Assetto Corsa / MoTeC export.

circuits.name: Autodromo Enzo e Dino Ferrari (Imola)
aliases: autodromo enzo e dino ferrari grand prix
autodromo internazionale enzo e dino ferrari
circuits.source: Corner order and names: official Imola circuit layout. Positions: fitted against speed minima of full laps recorded in Assetto Corsa (fn_imola, imola; 3 cars).
circuits.notes: Numbering is by named complex (a chicane or double apex counts once). Rivazza is split in two apexes because both are detected as separate speed minima. Variante Bassa (corner 9, about 0.94 of the lap; the Assetto Corsa racing line puts its minimum radius, 478 m, at 0.923) is tabulated with kind flat_out: with a GT4 or a prototype it has no speed minimum (speed keeps rising in 26 laps of 5 cars), so a speed/curvature detector never produces an apex there and it is only found by the unified corner map (src/analytics/corner_map.py) from the track geometry and this table. A car that brakes there makes it an ordinary apex.

circuits.name: Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps
circuits.source: Corner order and names: official Spa-Francorchamps layout. Positions: fitted against speed minima and heading change of a full Assetto Corsa lap (ks_porsche_cayman_gt4_clubsport).
circuits.notes: Eau Rouge and Raidillon are one entry (flat-out compression). Rivage covers the right-hand hairpin; the left kink that follows it and the Paul Frere / Campus kinks are not named.

circuits.notes: Recognition only: corner names are not published until their positions are validated against telemetry.

circuits.name: Silverstone Circuit
circuits.source: Corner names and order: official Silverstone Grand Prix layout. Positions: fitted against speed minima and heading change of 5 full laps in 2 Assetto Corsa logs (ks_silverstone GP, Porsche 919 Hybrid); spread between laps <= 40 m.
circuits.notes: Grand Prix layout only (the 2.9 km International layout fails the length check and gets no names). Farm, Woodcote and the Maggotts-Becketts-Chapel complex are not named: no clear speed minimum or order not verified. Aintree has no speed minimum in fast cars and is only named when it is detected.

circuits.name: Brands Hatch
circuits.source: Corner names and order: official Brands Hatch Grand Prix layout. Positions: fitted against speed minima and heading change of ONE full Assetto Corsa lap (ks_brands_hatch, Ferrari 330 P4).
circuits.notes: Single-lap validation, hence medium. Only the first three corners are named; the order of Surtees, Hawthorns, Westfield, Dingle Dell, Sheene, Stirlings, Clark and Clearways was not verified against the data.

circuits.name: Autodromo Internazionale del Mugello
circuits.source: Corner names and order: official Mugello layout. Positions: fitted against speed minima and heading change of ONE full Assetto Corsa lap (mugello, Lotus Exos 125).
circuits.notes: Single-lap validation, hence medium. Only San Donato to Savelli are named; the Arrabbiata, Scarperia, Palagio, Correntaio, Biondetti and Bucine corners are not (order against detected apexes not verified).

circuits.name: Nurburgring Nordschleife
circuits.source: Nominal lap length from the official circuit data.
circuits.notes: Recognition only. Checked against one full real lap (McLaren P1): the Karussell is the only corner with an unmistakable signature, but the apex segmenter does not produce an apex there, so a name could never be assigned; with about 170 corners and a single log no other name has a verified position and order.

circuits.name: Circuit de Monaco
circuits.source: Corner names and order: official Monaco layout. Positions: fitted against speed minima and heading change of 3 full laps in 2 Assetto Corsa logs (monaco_2020; Porsche Carrera GT and Porsche GT2 RS); spread between laps <= 16 m.
circuits.notes: Only corners with an unmistakable signature are named. Beau Rivage, Massenet, Casino, Mirabeau Haute/Bas and the Piscine chicane are not named (no clear independent speed minimum or ambiguous position). The mod lap is about 2 % shorter than the nominal length.

circuits.name: Circuit de la Sarthe (Le Mans)
circuits.source: Corner names and order: official Circuit de la Sarthe layout. Positions: fitted against speed minima of 5 full laps in 2 Assetto Corsa logs (sx_lemans, Porsche 919 Hybrid); spread between laps <= 44 m on a 13.6 km lap.
circuits.notes: Only the slow corners are named. The two Mulsanne straight chicanes, Indianapolis, the Esses, Tertre Rouge and the Porsche Curves are not named (position or official name not verified). Lap measured 0.5 % short of nominal.
